summary: First test iteration for CareFlex MVP (public site + admin). All 27 backend pytest cases passed (public content, filters, lead/subscriber creation, auth, admin CRUD). All frontend flows passed (home hero, category tiles, EN/ES language toggle, footer contact form, product catalog search/coverage filter, resupply subscribe on category page, product detail + intake placeholder, provider referral, campaign landing 3-step form, contact form + map iframe, FAQ accordion, 3 blog posts + article content, 8 service-area counties, admin login redirect, admin dashboard with test session cookie, leads/subscribers tabs displaying submitted test data, products CRUD via UI).

issues: Green success toast overlaps the 'For Providers' nav link at the top after submitting referral (see screenshot) — minor z-index/positioning of Sonner top-center toast on this route; not blocking.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider top-right or offsetting Sonner toast position on pages with fixed header so success messages don't visually clip the nav.
Optional: add explicit /admin/logout data-testid coverage in a future auth teardown test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:187 — POST /api/leads returns doc with `_id` popped after insert; correct pattern, kept for reference.
server.py generic /api/admin/{resource} CRUD is DRY and clean; PUT drops incoming id/_id fields which is the right guard.
server.py /auth/session sets cookie with SameSite=None + Secure — correct for cross-site preview URL.
AuthContext.jsx correctly short-circuits /auth/me check when returning from OAuth (session_id in hash) — prevents 401 race.

Landing.jsx submit lacks try/catch — a failed /api/leads POST would leave the user stuck on step 3 with no error toast (silent failure). Consider wrapping api.post in try/catch and showing a toast on failure.
ResourceManager.jsx save() catches errors with `catch {}` and shows generic 'Save failed' — losing error detail; consider logging error or surfacing the server message.
